description: This line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates how three performance metrics—Recall, F1-score, and a third metric labeled "Metric (%)"—vary across five different model variants. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays the variants in order: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," is scaled linearly from approximately 56 to 66 percent, with tick marks at regular intervals of two percent. The plot includes three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers representing "Recall," a blue line with circular markers representing "F1-score," and a brown line with circular markers representing the unlabeled "Metric (%)." The purple "Recall" line starts at 65.49%, dips to 60.16%, rises to 63.75%, peaks at 64.06%, and ends at 65.44%. The blue "F1-score" line begins at 65.78%, drops to 59.64%, rises to 62.63%, falls to 59.67%, and concludes at 57.74%. The brown "Metric (%)" line starts at 65.49%, decreases to 60.16%, increases to 62.22%, declines to 59.67%, and ends at 56.82%. Each data point is annotated with its corresponding percentage value.
